"""Commit the reviewed instrumentation and actual finite qualification evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import copy
import re
import traceback

B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata')
W=G/'.worktree/diag-prefill-leaf-service-events-20261012'
L=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O=B/'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('leaf_publication_owner',O)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
env=dict(PATH=str(L/'venv/bin')+':'+str(L/'bin')+':/usr/bin:/bin',HOME='/home/yayoi',LANG='C.UTF-8',LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
def pin(p):return dict(path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size)
with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 out=B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-publication-root-v1';assert not out.exists();out.mkdir()
 r=dict(active=True,passed=False,complete=False,commands=[],gpu_executed=False,source=pin(Path(__file__)))
 def save():(out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
 owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save);r['commands']=owner.commands
 def run(label,args,wall=180,allowed=(0,)):
  c,so,se=owner.run(label,args,env,W,wall=wall,cpu=wall*2,rss_cap=4<<30,text_cap=16<<20,total_cap=64<<20,file_cap=16<<20)
  r.setdefault('evidence',{})[label]=dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text());save()
  assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed,label
  return so.read_text()
 try:
  roots=[B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-build-root-v1',B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-build-root-v2',B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-lints-root-v1',B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-lints-root-v2',B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-host-fixture-root-v1']
  roots += [B/('main-prefill-leaf-service-fixture-'+mode+'-'+value+'-root-v1') for mode,value in [('free','1'),('contrib-llvm','1'),('free','unset'),('free','0'),('free','01'),('free','true')]]
  roots += [B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-fixture-free-1-small-root-v1']
  proofs={str(root):json.loads((root/'record.json').read_text()) for root in roots}
  assert all(not v['active'] and all(m.closed(c) for c in v['commands']) for v in proofs.values())
  assert sum(not v['passed'] for v in proofs.values())==1
  assert not proofs[str(roots[2])]['passed'] and proofs[str(roots[3])]['passed']
  f=W/'bench/results/2026-10-12-prefill-production-leaf-events';assert not f.exists();f.mkdir(parents=True)
  index={}
  for root,value in proofs.items():
   original=Path(root)/'record.json';target=f/'receipts'/ (Path(root).name+'.json');target.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
   derivative=copy.deepcopy(value);changes=[]
   if 'main-prefill-leaf-service-fixture-' in root:
    for label,evidence in derivative.get('evidence',{}).items():
     text=evidence.get('stderr','')
     selected=[line for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('strata prefill service ') or re.search(r'error|warning|failed|fatal|unsupported',line,re.I)]
     if text:
      evidence['stderr']='\n'.join(selected)+('\n' if selected else '')
      evidence['full_stderr_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest();evidence['full_stderr_bytes']=len(text.encode())
      changes.append(dict(json_pointer='/evidence/'+label+'/stderr',original_bytes=len(text.encode()),retained_bytes=len(evidence['stderr'].encode()),reason='Successful API trace retired; complete service summaries/categories and all warning/error/failure lines retained.'))
   target.write_text(json.dumps(derivative,indent=2)+'\n');index[root]=dict(original=pin(original),archived=str(target.relative_to(W)),archived_sha256=m.sha(target),derivations=changes)
  (f/'receipts/index.json').write_text(json.dumps(index,indent=2)+'\n')
  reports=['research-prefill16k-complete-arena-admission-round279-v1.txt','research-expert-copy2d-cohort-caller-admission-round280-v1.txt','research-sycl-v2-command-event-timing-contract-round281-v1.txt','research-decode-t1-pool-worker-recipe-admission-round282-v1.txt','implementation-prefill-leaf-service-events-source-v1.txt']
  report_index={}
  for name in reports:
   p=B/'research-20261009'/name;target=f/'research'/ (name+'.json');target.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True);target.write_text(json.dumps(dict(original=pin(p),text=p.read_text()),indent=2)+'\n');report_index[name]=dict(original=pin(p),archived=str(target.relative_to(W)))
  previous=G/'.worktree/sync-upstream-v0143-server-lifecycle-20261012/bench/results/2026-10-12-v0143-server-completion/report-registry-v165.json'
  corrections=['R279 QSA floor is2049.141 MiB /2.001GiB at16K for listed exact-source terms, not its prose2.2GiB; no actual fit/admission claim.','R280 once ran read-only git status with empty output; no source or Git mutation.','R281 command_start/end are device spans; queue profiling changes instrumentation condition, not transparent normal-queue service.','R282 worker sweep must fix pool-tasks18; earlier instrumented CPU callback is not a clean performance baseline.','Main changed atomic diagnostic failure handling and new-header lint database; original failed lint receipt remains FAILED.','Main alone executed both builds, lints, host sanitizers and seven finite GPU fixtures; no new32K model/performance qualification yet at this boundary.']
  (f/'report-registry-v166.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(research_completed=792,prior=pin(previous),new_reports=report_index,main_only_test_execution=True,main_adjustments=corrections),indent=2)+'\n')
  controller_names=['main-prefill-leaf-service-build-v1.py','main-prefill-leaf-service-build-v2.py','main-prefill-leaf-service-lints-v1.py','main-prefill-leaf-service-lints-v2.py','main-prefill-leaf-service-host-fixture-v1.py','prefill-leaf-service-host-fixture-v1.cpp','main-prefill-leaf-service-fixture-v1.py','main-prefill-leaf-service-model-v1.py','main-prefill-leaf-service-source-review-v1.json','main-prefill-leaf-service-source-review-v2.json',Path(__file__).name]
  for name in controller_names:
   p=B/name;target=f/'controllers'/ (name+'.json');target.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True);target.write_text(json.dumps(dict(original=pin(p),text=p.read_text()),indent=2)+'\n')
  (f/'RESULTS.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(builds_passed=['free','contrib-llvm'],new_lint_findings=[],host_sanitizers_passed=True,gpu_fixture_count=7,scope='Actual Runtime queues, five pinned copy commands, production grouped GEMM, output/canary parity, scope reset and exactflag admission. No fullmodel speed/quality claim.',full_context_262144_runtime_qualified=False,restore_qualified=False,model_runtime_qualified=False,selected_model_binary_unchanged=True,decisions=corrections),indent=2)+'\n')
  (f/'REPORT.md').write_text('# Production prefill command-event instrumentation\n\nThe opt-in diagnostic retains exact returned events for copies, native grouped dequantization and grouped GEMM. It enables queue profiling only for exact `STRATA_PREFILL_SERVICE_EVENTS=1`. It adds no production wait or profiling tag. The final existing checked sync precedes event queries; zero or invalid timestamps, caps and query failures make the diagnostic incomplete.\n\nBoth free and contrib-llvm builds passed with LLVM7.1.1, Clang22.1 and libSYCL9. The initial lint failed; Main corrected the empty catch and supplied actual SYCL compiler flags for the new header. The subsequent lint has no new finding. The original failure is retained.\n\nThe host-only ASan/UBSan fixture passed cap200001, overlapping-scope rejection, unavailable profiling, negative host clock and scope reset checks. Seven finite GPU fixtures passed on Arc B570: profiling1 in both modes, unset/0/01/true in free mode, and the simulated smaller configuration with XMX disabled. All1280 outputs and16 canaries matched; all captured command timestamps were positive. No fresh GPU fault or reset occurred. The smaller fixture checks DP4a and queue behavior; full smaller-model memory admission, integrated graphics and NVIDIA remain unverified.\n\nThe current selected model binary remains0691/ed65. The new instrumentation has no32K model qualification or speed result at this boundary. Its counts cover selected leaf commands, and event spans can overlap. They do not establish physical PCIe bandwidth, total GPU work or idle gaps. Next: candidate startup, then one supervised32K event diagnostic with exact16-token/LP5 comparison.262144-token input and RESTORE remain unqualified.\n\nReceipts, source/controller pins and original reports are archived here. Raw successful logs will be reviewed after the model boundary under the measurement lock.\n')
  added=sorted(str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in f.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
  run('report-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*added],300)
  run('whole-reuse',[str(L/'venv/bin/reuse'),'lint','--quiet'],180)
  assert not run('local-identity',['/usr/bin/git','config','--local','--get-regexp',r'^user\.(name|email)$'],allowed=(0,1)).strip()
  assert run('global-name',['/usr/bin/git','config','--global','user.name']).strip()
  assert run('global-email',['/usr/bin/git','config','--global','user.email']).strip()
  run('stage',['/usr/bin/git','add','CMakeLists.txt','include/strata/core/service_events.hpp','include/strata/core/runtime.hpp','src/core/device.cpp','src/core/gpu.cpp','src/kernels/xe/xmx_gemm.cpp','src/kernels/xe/iq_kernels.cpp','src/prefill/prefill.cpp','tools/prefill_service_event_test.cpp',str(f.relative_to(W))])
  run('commit',['/usr/bin/git','commit','-m','feat(diag): collect bounded prefill command service events'])
  run('push',['/usr/bin/git','push','-u','origin','diag/prefill-leaf-service-events-20261012'],300)
  r['commit']=run('head',['/usr/bin/git','rev-parse','HEAD']).strip();assert not run('clean',['/usr/bin/git','status','--porcelain']).strip();r['complete']=True
 except BaseException as error:r.update(error=repr(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
 finally:r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc());r['passed']=bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'));save()
 print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['passed','complete','error','commit']}));raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
